thread.readOnly: Member posting is paused in Chirpy. Other clients may still send messages.
thread.joinToSend: Join this room to send messages.
thread.blockedNote: This conversation is blocked. Messages and receipts are hidden.

settings.blockedHelp: Manage blocked conversations in Chats → Blocked. Blocking hides this direct conversation and stops your outgoing messages and receipts. It does not remove messages from shared rooms.
thread.receiptMeaning: The peer sent a read receipt at this time. It does not identify an exact message.
thread.adminPosting: Member posting is paused in Chirpy. Administrators can still post; other clients may ignore this policy.
settings.pictureHelp: Set your profile picture on ENS to show the same avatar across apps.
settings.walletIdentity: Connected wallet identity. ENS profile data appears when available.
settings.connectIdentity: Connect a wallet to use your address and ENS profile.
settings.walletConnectIdentity: Connect with WalletConnect to use your address and ENS profile.
settings.mockMessaging: Messaging runs locally in mock mode.
settings.connectMessaging: Connect a wallet above to enable encrypted messaging.
settings.messagingSignature: One-time signature to create your encrypted inbox. No gas, no transaction.
settings.resolverHint: Type a name to resolve its address, or an address to look up its ENS name.
settings.resolverInvalid: Enter a .eth name or a 0x address.
settings.resolverNoName: No primary ENS name found for this address.
settings.resolverError: ENS lookup unavailable. Try again later.
settings.receiptHelp: When on, Chirpy sends read receipts in direct chats. Turn off to stop sending receipts from this device. Previously sent receipts cannot be withdrawn.
settings.syncActive: On for this browser session, for up to 24 hours. Encrypted preferences are stored by the sync service.
settings.syncPaused: Paused after restart. Re-enable with your wallet to resume encrypted sync.
settings.syncOff: Off. Preferences stay on this device. Enable with two gas-free signatures; the device key stays in memory.
settings.mockMode: Mock mode: local chats on this device.
settings.xmtpMode: XMTP mode: encrypted DMs and rooms.
settings.orgHelp: Import an org config or create one. Chats stay inside the active org.
settings.revokeHelp: Revoke all current sync device authorizations if a device is lost or compromised. Each device will need fresh wallet authorization. Saved encrypted data is retained.
settings.footer: Direct messages use XMTP when enabled. Your profile picture comes from ENS. Preferences live on this device unless sync is on.
settings.revokeSignature: You'll be asked for one wallet signature to authorize the revoke.
settings.pictureSet: ✓ Picture set on ENS — {name}. Shown across apps.
settings.notResolved: {name} does not currently resolve to an address.
settings.revokeLimit: Your messaging inbox is at XMTP's limit of 10 devices/sessions. To enable messaging on this device, Chirpy will revoke the existing installations on your inbox.
settings.revokeEffect: This signs you out of Chirpy messaging on every other device and browser you have enabled. Each will need to re-enable messaging with one signature to reconnect. Your conversations and history are not deleted.
update.unsupported: In-app updates run in the desktop app. The web app updates on reload; iOS updates via the App Store.
update.idle: Up to date as far as we know — check for a new version.
update.title: Software update
status.syncEnabled: Encrypted sync is enabled for this browser session, for up to 24 hours.
status.syncRevoked: Sync is off and this device authorization was revoked.
status.syncLocalOff: Sync is off locally. Use Revoke all sync devices to revoke earlier sessions.
status.syncAllRevoked: All existing sync device authorizations were revoked. Your encrypted saved data is retained.
status.syncChanged: Settings changed while syncing. Your local choices are saved; enable sync again to retry.
status.syncFailed: Sync failed. Local changes are saved on this device; retry sync when available.
status.syncUnreadable: Remote sync could not be read. Local data is unchanged.
status.syncExpired: Sync authorization expired. Re-enable sync with your wallet.
status.syncConnect: Connect a wallet before enabling encrypted sync.
status.syncConflict: Another device changed sync again. Try enabling sync again.
status.syncUnsaved: Encrypted sync was not saved. Try again; local data has been kept.
status.syncUndecryptable: Encrypted sync could not be decrypted. Remote data has been preserved.
status.revokeUnconfirmed: Sync stopped locally; revocation was not confirmed.
status.revokeConnect: Connect a wallet to revoke sync devices.
status.revokeRetry: Revocation was not confirmed. Retry when connected.
status.keyRejected: Wallet signature was rejected or unavailable. Sync stayed off.

status.syncReadFailed: Unable to read encrypted sync. Try again when storage is available.
status.syncWrongService: Sync service authorization is unavailable or has the wrong origin.
status.revokeServerUnconfirmed: Sync stopped locally, but server revocation was not confirmed. Revoke all sync devices when connected.

settings.orgRecoveryHelp: Some saved organization data could not be loaded. Valid organizations remain available, and the original data has been retained for recovery.

dialog.policyHelp: Posting and attachment policies apply in Chirpy. Other clients can ignore them; they do not remove members or erase message history.
dialog.gatekeeperHelp: Gated rooms need an external gatekeeper. After creation, publish the room ID in the gatekeeper registry so other members can discover and join it.
dialog.accessHelp: Who may join. Multiple rules combine by the mode below.

dialog.presetHelp: Example configurations for the two Bittrees apps. Illustrative contracts must be verified before use.
dialog.configHelp: Paste an exported organization, or pick a preset above.
